case_results.reason: Actual neutral JPEG candidates require nonempty regular bytes, stored JPEG format, positive dimensions, one frame and full pixel decode. A real truncated JPEG retains readable header dimensions but fails full decode. No-file, zero-length, malformed, wrong-format, numbered sequence output, nonzero, absent, string, extra-output, timed-out and cancelled controlled native outcomes are never finalized or counted. Real >260 native candidate validation/move passes.

Each alpha fallback/scale exclusively reserves a fresh candidate. Later missing/failed attempts cannot reuse a valid earlier above-cap JPEG; a later valid fallback is independently decoded and finalized.

External file/directory arrivals after candidate validation and before image/video finalization survive unchanged. The real no-overwrite operation also rejects arrivals after its availability check; source/sentinel preservation and partial status are asserted.

Stable opaque video bytes pass through a reserved owned partial before a final name exists, then match source SHA256 and timestamps. Controlled source length/modification changes, incomplete copies, nonempty reserved partials and thrown copy interruptions never become stable final success.

Explicit per-file ownership prevents cleanup of arrivals before reservation. Failed image attempts and interrupted video copies remove only exact owned partials and empty owned directories, preserving numbered outputs and unrelated neighboring files.

implementation_notes: Exclusively reserve a neutral candidate with FileMode.CreateNew for every native attempt, including alpha fallback and lower scale. ProcessRunner remains conversion-only; candidate validation calls the verified executable directly.

Videos stream from FileShare.Read sources to FileShare.None reserved owned partials; flush/dispose precedes source length/time and partial length checks. Regression hashes verify opaque video bytes without adding runtime content hashing.

Require equal candidate/final volume roots and use File.Move(String,String) without overwrite for image and video finalization. Exact owned-file cleanup and nonrecursive empty-directory deletion preserve unknown neighbors.

Any item error returns partial status 2. Existing public invocation forms, deterministic naming, cap/scales and conversion settings remain; duplicate early-key registration, source-frame selection, colour and comprehensive native lifecycle stay later scope.
